_doc: Analyst corrections to the object index, applied by aerial_encode after dedup and before anything is written, so objects.jsonl, the overlay, the painted preview, the index sidecar and the triples all carry the corrected class. objects[]: video = the clip's file stem (omit for any clip); object_id = the object in that clip's objects.jsonl; class = the new class, or drop: true to remove the object (a duplicate detection of something already tracked); expect = {class, first_frame} the object must still have, or the correction is skipped with a message (object ids are deterministic for one object layer on one clip and renumber when the layer changes); note = why. A relabelled object is source 'manual', keeps what the heads said in 'detected', and counts as corroborated. The default file is corrections.json beside object_layer.json; --corrections PATH|none overrides.
